csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of the ITB is to establish a Contract for B115 HVAC Design Build to provide all architectural and engineering (A&E) services, labor, materials, equipment, and supervision required to design, install, and commission a complete, turn-key HVAC system for the 11,500 SF space in Building 115, as demarcated on the provided site plan.for the benefit of Oregon Military Department ( OMD ). The Work contemplated under this Contract includes all labor, materials, transportation, equipment and services for, and incidental to, the completion of all construction Work in connection with the project described in the ITB and Contract Documents.

title: Design-Build for FY 26 Building 115 HVAC
short_description: Design-build HVAC replacement for an 11,500-square-foot military building in Portland.
project_location: Building 115, 6801 NE Cornfoot Rd, Portland, Oregon 97218, USA
project_scope: Design-build delivery for a complete turnkey HVAC system in Building 115 for an approximately 11,500 square foot space. Scope includes all architectural and engineering services, labor, materials, equipment, supervision, installation, and commissioning, plus all incidental construction work required for completion.
services: Design-build services including architectural and engineering services, rehabilitation/refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, installation, and commissioning of HVAC systems.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an HVAC/mechanical building-services project, which is outside sbp's core focus.
- Small-scale refurbishment of an existing military building with no notable structural or long-span challenge.
- Tender is design-build, but the planning component is centered on MEP/HVAC rather than structural engineering.
- Military facility projects are explicitly low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated from the tender range of $900.0K-$1.2M; midpoint used in USD.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee stated. Available information: design-build contract for HVAC replacement/refurbishment in an 11,500 SF building with total construction cost range of 900000 to 1200000 USD.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: design-build/developer, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds stated in the source.
contracting_authority: Oregon Military Department, Portland, Oregon, USA. Contact: Michelle Johnson. Phone: 503-335-5316. Fax: 503-945-3584. Email: michelle.johnson.38@us.af.mil. Website: https://oregonbuys.gov/bso/external/bidDetail.sda?docId=S-24800-00017106&external=true&parentUrl=close
notes: Project number TQKD26-2012; contract number S-24800-00017106. State and federal funding. Prevailing wage may apply. Pre-bid conference: 2026-06-23 09:00 AM PDT in Building 140 CES Classroom; attendance recommended with prior coordination 72 hours in advance. Although categorized under buildings, the project is essentially an HVAC/MEP refurbishment for a military facility and is not structurally relevant for sbp.
